This is where I'll be writing notes on math.

Math renders in the usual way — inline like $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$, or set apart in display:

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}.
$$

See the [theorem demo](../theorem-demo/) for theorem environments and a worked computation.
